name: table-cell
body:
A table cell (domain.entity.table): its content is inline Markdown (markdown-allowed-subset) plus the cell extensions `{br}` (line break) and `{…}` attribute groups (table-cell-attributes). It renders to HTML with `{br}` as `
`, and carries the declared cell attributes the cell sets (domain.value.cell-attribute), each typed by its declaration. A cell reaches a layout as a map with `html` and `attrs`, and header cells carry attributes exactly as body cells do (table-layout-context).
